status: Digital prototype source; physical assembly and qualification pending
architecture: Thin bare metal fork supported through two vertical shear webs at its base; fixed side carriers attach to the original finger's side axes
coordinate_system: Nail-plane X across the fork, Y toward the root, Z into the finger; origin from the retained nail contact report

notes: The original hard nail is removed only in this separate frame revision.
A small loose crescent left by this cut is discarded only if it remains within the declared distal strip; the three TPU attachment regions are checked separately.
Separate side pockets clear the sensing webs while preserving the central frame material and attachment regions.
The intended replacement preserves the source nail's leading footprint and contact plane.
The original TPU and its three attachment bores are retained until interference checks establish otherwise.

nail.material_candidate: Wrought 17-4PH stainless steel, H900 condition, supplier certificate required
notes: Dimensions are initial design variables. Static interference, stiffness, stress, gauge response and real mounting checks are still required.
The material modulus is taken as a nominal model input. It is not a certificate, fatigue allowable or hardware load rating.
Thin leading edges remain bare; diagonal foil grids read shear in vertical webs behind them.

gauges.measurement_axis: Diagonal grids at +45 and -45 degrees to local Y on each web's outer YZ face
gauges.selection_status: Manufacturer carrier size, full-bridge shear pattern and steel compensation verified; bonding and complete integration still in development

clamp_screws: Left: two M3 x 8, 90-degree flat head
Right: two M3 x 6, 90-degree flat head
mount.main_mount_screws_candidate: Two M3 x 40, 90-degree flat head from the right; threaded left carrier. Confirm actual stack and engagement.

complete_finger_candidate.nail_readout: Reuse C1.1 dual-bridge PCB with a distinct nail firmware and recording identity on one RP2040 Pico
complete_finger_candidate.soft_region: Four retained R1 TPU contact cells, two ADS1115 breakouts and the explicit wiring in nail_electronics.json; integration software remains in development
notes: Nail-base sensing alone does not measure TPU-only contact.
Both nail and soft-region channels must be present before this candidate enters the all-region comparison.

structural_screen.clamp_model: Bonded metal nail-to-carrier interfaces; fixed faces at the original side-support contact pads
limits: The original printed frame and attachment compliance are excluded from this first metal load-path screen.
Actual bolted joints, steel condition, gauge bonding, temperature, contact and dynamic force require measurements.
The internal grid positions of the purchased full-bridge pattern are not inferred from the catalog illustration.
